summary: The authors have addressed the single required revision from the prior closure review by including an artifact‑grounded enumeration of the four repaired/discordant pairs (pair-000090, pair-000341, pair-000381, pair-000413) with violation codes, short descriptions, repair invocation and per‑pair model‑call counts, and artifact references/SHAs. The manuscript is preregistered, artifact-grounded, and transparent about limitations (single model, synthetic tasks, unexecuted templated comparator). No outstanding critical issues remain; I recommend finalisation after minor optional polish.
optional_revisions: Ensure the repaired/discordant enumeration is presented as a compact LaTeX table (≤1 table) in the final IEEE two‑column PDF to match the prior request precisely and improve reader scanability (the artifact references and SHAs are already present).
Add one short sentence in Methods explaining the rationale for the preregistered conditional exact McNemar choice and why the bootstrap CI is labeled exploratory.
In Results, add one sentence summarizing the observed task difficulty buckets (use terminal_factual_accounting difficulty_summary) to aid external‑validity assessment.
